governance.note: The 2026-07-07-nyiso-56-measured-zonal keeper recipe VERBATIM (byte-faithful replay of its meta.json via replay_keeper.build_kwargs) with exactly ONE change: temp_dependent_derate=True. This replaces the flat EIA-860 net-summer / _SUMMER_CLASS_DERATE capacity treatment with a per-class curve in MEASURED hourly zone dry-bulb temperature (fleet.generators_to_fleet_arrays). The slopes/reference temps are literature-sourced physics (arXiv:2311.07001, CPUC R.21-10-002; docs/parameter-citations.md) — NOT fitted to any price/volume residual — so they add NO free parameter (the DOF ledger is byte-identical to nyiso-56's, n_residual unchanged at 5). For CC/CT the curve is rescaled so its Jun-Sep mean reproduces the existing net-summer capability (capacity-neutral reshape); COAL/ST_GAS take an additive hot-hour condenser derate. This is a rule-11 physical input, forward-reproducible in both backcast and forecast: exactly the 'prefer accurate/measured data over an estimate' move, kept even though it worsens the 2023 fit (rule 1: a real market behaviour stays in even if it makes the fit worse; fix the root cause per rule 11 rather than revert the mechanism).
governance.residuals_note: RESULT vs the nyiso-56 keeper (identical recipe, flat derate): the temperature reshape is directionally correct and IMPROVES 2024/2025 — C3a mean 2024 33.18->34.88 (actual 35.95; closes the keeper's -7.7% undershoot toward -3.0%), 2025 56.21->61.71 (actual 60.74; -7.5%->+1.6%); C8 ST_GAS forced-energy share FALLS in all three years (30.5/44.6/38.2% -> 27.8/41.2/34.4%). C1/C2/C4 essentially unchanged (capacity-neutral reshape; no coal fleet). But it REGRESSES 2023: C3a 30.29 actual, model 31.59->37.21 (+1.6% -> +22.8%, beyond the 10% commercial band), C3b NRMSE 0.188->0.42, C3c 21h->39h (>$300; actual DA 1h / RT 10h). ROOT CAUSE (fully diagnosed 2026-07-09, results SUMMARY + issue): the 2023 regression is downstate LOCATIONAL RESERVE-SCARCITY over-firing, NOT load-shed and NOT transmission. On warm-but-moderate afternoons (Aug 14/21, 30-31C, real RT $45-65) temp-derate trims the downstate CT/peaker fleet that supplies the East 10-min (1200 MW/$775 RCPF) and SENY 30-min (1300 MW/$500 RCPF) reserves; the requirement shorts and the correctly-SOM-sourced RCPF penalties fire and stack (~$1300), lifting every downstate LBMP to the $2000 cap. Annual load-shed is ~830 MWh (5 thin-margin instances); the keeper sheds ZERO yet still posts 15 false >$300 hours, so this is a PRE-EXISTING downstate reserve-adequacy weakness the temp-derate merely amplifies. The reserve requirements/penalties are primary-source (NYISO SOM) and are NOT tuned. The physical suspect is that the temp-derate CT slope (0.0126/C, a frame-GT literature value) over-derates NYC's largely aeroderivative peaker fleet; the condition-varying downstate reserve requirement (#1344 Ask-B) that would also discipline it is data-blocked. Neither is fixed here — the owner promotes on structural faithfulness (rule 1) with the 2023 regression DISCLOSED as an open MODEL MISS, not laundered as an accepted limitation.
governance.determination_note: The 2023 C3a (+22.8%) and C3b (NRMSE 0.42) misses are DELIBERATELY NOT ledgered — they are diagnosed MODEL MISSES (downstate reserve-scarcity over-firing), not accepted measured-input limitations, so they remain FAILs and the honest determination is NOT-YET. The owner promotes this run as NYISO's most structurally-faithful keeper (rule 1, temp-derate > flat net-summer) with the 2023 regression fully DISCLOSED and tracked as an open root-cause item — NOT laundered into a caveat to inflate the grade.

_open_items: (1) 2023 downstate reserve-scarcity OVER-firing (C3a +22.8%, C3c 39h) — MODEL MISS, open. Two levers, both improve the keeper baseline too: (a) differentiate the temp-derate CT slope by prime-mover technology (aeroderivative NYC peakers derate less than the frame-GT 0.0126/C literature slope) — a physics refinement needing EIA-860 turbine-model data + cross-ISO validation; (b) #1344 condition-varying downstate reserve requirement (Ask-B series, data-blocked). See the nyiso-58 handoff prompt / results SUMMARY. (2) All nyiso-56 open items carry forward unchanged (downstate import discipline, SENY reserve MW, C3c DA-vs-RT scoring basis, gitignored clean partitions).
